links.comparator_used: Random selection baseline (~0.17 no-show precision) for Top-N targeting; no-reminder control group in the randomized call trial
links.outcome: Top-N precision of true no-shows among targeted patients; overall no-show rate in the randomized phone-call trial
links.effect: Top-10 precision 0.38 and Top-20 precision 0.31 for XGBoost vs random baseline 0.17; no-show rate 21.9% intervention vs 22.0% control (P = .48)
links.tradeoff: 42.3% of called patients were not reached; model performance fell in the prospective test (AUROC 0.65 to 0.61) due to data drift
links.quote: All models outperformed random guessing (baseline: 0.17), with XGBoost performing best, achieving precision scores of 0.38 and 0.31 for the Top 10 and 20 predictions, respectively.

links.comparator_used: High-risk patients flagged by the model but receiving no reminder call (control group)
links.effect: 21.9% intervention (274 appointments) vs 22.0% control (460 appointments), P = .48; reached patients 18.4% vs not reached 26.7%
links.tradeoff: Limited reach: 116 of 274 (42.3%) not reached, with no retry; calls added scheduling-staff workload
links.quote: Overall, the phone call trial showed no significant reduction in the no-show rate between the control (22.0%) and intervention (21.9%) groups ( P- value: .48), as shown in Table 2 .

links.comparator_used: Retrospective hold-out validation performance before go-live
links.outcome: Prospective model discrimination (AUROC/AUPRC) detected in the silent live test
links.effect: AUROC 0.61 and AUPRC 0.24 in the silent live test (5882 appointments) vs 0.65 and 0.29 on the validation set; drop attributed in part to data drift
links.tradeoff: Required a 13-month silent period before the intervention could begin
links.quote: On this dataset, the model achieved an AUROC of 0.61 and an AUPRC of 0.24, a reduction in performance when compared to the validation data performance (AUROC: 0.65, AUPRC: 0.29).

design_hint: targeted phone call reminder for high-risk patients; prospective evaluation and drift monitoring
